text_en: When Samuel became old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
text_cn: 撒慕尔年老的时候，立了他的两个儿子作以色列的民长。

text_en: The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah; they were judges in Beer-sheba.
text_cn: 长子名叫约厄耳，次子名叫阿彼雅，同在贝尔舍巴作民长。

text_en: Yet his sons did not follow in his ways, but turned aside after gain; they took bribes and perverted justice.
text_cn: 但是他这两个儿子不走他所走的路，却贪图厚利，接受贿赂，歪曲正理。

text_en: Then all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah,
text_cn: 以色列众长老便联合起来，往辣玛去见撒慕尔，

text_en: and said to him, “You are old and your sons do not follow in your ways; appoint for us, then, a king to govern us, like other nations. ”
text_cn: 对他说：“看，你已经老了，你的儿子们不走你所走的路。如今请你给我们立一位君王治理我们，如同各国一样。”

text_en: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to govern us. ” Samuel prayed to the Lord ,
text_cn: 撒慕尔听到他们要求说：“请给我们立一位君王治理我们”，大为不悦，便去祈求上主。

text_en: and the Lord said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me from being king over them.
text_cn: 上主对撒慕尔说：“凡民众向你所说的话，你都要听从，因为他们不是抛弃你，而是抛弃我作他们的君王。

text_en: Just as they have done to me, from the day I brought them up out of Egypt to this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so also they are doing to you.
text_cn: 自从我领他们出离埃及直到今日，凡他们做的，无非是抛弃我而事奉别的神；他们现在也这样来对待你。

text_en: Now then, listen to their voice; only—you shall solemnly warn them, and show them the ways of the king who shall reign over them. ”
text_cn: 好吧！你就听从他们的要求，但必须清楚警告他们，要他们明了那统治他们的君王所享有的权利。”

text_en: So Samuel reported all the words of the Lord to the people who were asking him for a king.
text_cn: 撒慕尔把上主的一切话，转告给那向他要求君王的人民，

text_en: He said, “These will be the ways of the king who will reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them to his chariots and to be his horsemen, and to run before his chariots;
text_cn: 说：“那要统治你们的君王所享有的权利是﹕他要征用你们的儿子，去充当车夫马夫，在他的车前奔走；

text_en: and he will appoint for himself commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest, and to make his implements of war and the equipment of his chariots.
text_cn: 委派他们做千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长；令他们耕种他的田地，收割他的庄稼，替他制造作战的武器和战车的用具；

text_en: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.
text_cn: 要征用你们的女儿为他配制香料，烹调食物；

text_en: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive orchards and give them to his courtiers.
text_cn: 要拿你们最好的庄田、葡萄园和橄榄林，赐给他的臣仆；

text_en: He will take one-tenth of your grain and of your vineyards and give it to his officers and his courtiers.
text_cn: 征收你们庄田和葡萄园出产的十分之一，赐给他的宦官和臣仆；

text_en: He will take your male and female slaves, and the best of your cattle and donkeys, and put them to his work.
text_cn: 使用你们的仆婢和你们最好的牛驴，替他作工；

text_en: He will take one-tenth of your flocks, and you shall be his slaves.
text_cn: 征收你们的羊群十分之一；至于你们自己，还应作他的奴隶。

text_en: And in that day you will cry out because of your king, whom you have chosen for yourselves; but the Lord will not answer you in that day. ”
text_cn: 到那一天，你们必要因你们所选的君王发出哀号；但那一天，上主也不理你们了。”

text_en: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; they said, “No! but we are determined to have a king over us,
text_cn: 但是，人民不愿听从撒慕尔的话，却对他说：“不！我们非要一位君王管理我们不可。

text_en: so that we also may be like other nations, and that our king may govern us and go out before us and fight our battles. ”
text_cn: 我们也要像一般异民一样，有我们的君王来治理我们，率领我们出征作战。”

text_en: When Samuel had heard all the words of the people, he repeated them in the ears of the Lord .
text_cn: 撒慕尔听见百姓所说的这一切话，就转告给上主听。

text_en: The Lord said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice and set a king over them. ” Samuel then said to the people of Israel, “Each of you return home. ”
text_cn: 上主对撒慕尔说：“你听从他们的话，给他们一位君王吧！”撒慕尔就吩咐以色列人说：“你们各自暂回本城去。”
